name: LANG-1323 Java 28 upstream control

on:
  push:
    branches: ['validation/LANG-1323-java28-base']

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  date-parser-control:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      with:
        repository: apache/commons-lang
        ref: c89cdf682fe21b0c39759cf58186ed5336a105d4
        persist-credentials: false
    - uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9
      with:
        path: ~/.m2/repository
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-maven-
    - name: Set up JDK 28-ea
      uses: actions/setup-java@b843ebf9b913146b38da2eaa7aeddf76074ae1ad
      with:
        distribution: temurin
        java-version: 28-ea
    - name: Baseline date-parser tests
      run: mvn --errors --show-version --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Ddoclint=all -Dtest=FastDateParserJava15BugTest,FastDateParserTest test
workflow.scope: Dedicated branch-only push trigger, no schedule. This metadata head is the control workflow commit, not the source being tested.

command.scope: Only the two failing date-parser classes. This is not a full baseline default build or a repeated ordinary matrix.
